mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate reduced economic activity and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the FEDFUNDS rate increased by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.3 percentage points within a month signals a strengthening labor market, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate increased consumer spending and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where the UNRATE decreased by more than 0.3 percentage points within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP by more than 2% year-over-year signals strong economic demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate increased corporate earnings and economic growth.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where GDPC1 increased by more than 2% year-over-year.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 1% month-over-month signals increased economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate increased corporate earnings and economic growth.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where INDPRO increased by more than 1% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in retail and food services sales by more than 2% month-over-month signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where RSAFS decreased by more than 2% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls by more than 200,000 jobs month-over-month signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate increased consumer spending and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where PAYEMS increased by more than 200,000 jobs month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds the CPI by more than 2 percentage points, it signals a restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate reduced economic activity and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS exceeded CPIAUCSL by more than 2 percentage points.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts increase by more than 5% month-over-month and the unemployment rate decreases by more than 0.3 percentage points within the same month, it signals a strong demand environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate increased economic activity and corporate earnings.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increase > 5% in 1 month AND UNRATE decrease > 0.3pp in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where HOUST increased by more than 5% and UNRATE decreased by more than 0.3 percentage points within the same month.
